Bulk actions work end-to-end (select, tag, mark read, archive; delete confined to the archive) with zero errors. Here's your walk.

---

### 🔗 http://maker:4001 (refresh)

Save a few links first (e.g. `Alpha`, `Beta`, `Gamma`).

**Action A — Select and act together**
1. Each card now has a **checkbox**. Tick two of them — a blue **action bar** appears: *"2 selected."*
2. Type `news` in its **add tag** box and press **Add tag** — both selected links gain **#news** at once.
3. Click **Mark read** or **To read** to change both, or **Archive** to tidy both away in one go.

**Action B — Apply to everything currently shown**
1. Narrow the library first (type a search, or click a tab/tag). Then in the bar click **"Select all N shown."**
2. Every link matching your current view/search/tag is selected — so a bulk action applies to the whole matching set, not just what you hand-picked. Use **remove tag…** to strip a tag from all of them.

**Action C — Deletion stays safe**
1. In the main views the bar offers tag changes, read/unread, and **Archive** — but **no Delete**.
2. Go to the **Archived** tab, select some, and only there does **Delete** appear (with a confirmation). Same safeguard as single links: nothing is permanently removed from your main library.

---

### The choices I made — please confirm

- **"Select all N shown"** is how I interpreted *"apply to all matching the current search, tag, or view"* — it grabs exactly the currently-showing set. (Once we add a links-per-page limit in display preferences, "all shown" could mean the whole matching set rather than one page — I'll make sure that stays true then.)
- **Add tag** is a typed box; **remove tag** is a menu of tags present in your selection.
- **Bulk delete only in the Archived view**, behind confirmation — consistent with single-link deletion.
- After **archive/delete** the selection clears; after tag or read changes it **stays**, so you can chain actions.
